questions.question: How did the Gibeonites trick Israel into a treaty?
options: By threatening open war if refused a treaty
By pretending to come from a far country
By bringing lavish gifts to Joshua
By offering bribes of silver and gold
questions.answer: By pretending to come from a far country

questions.question: What did Israel fail to do before making the treaty?
options: Pray for rain in the drought

questions.question: When the deception was discovered, Israel kept their oath but made the Gibeonites woodcutters and water carriers.
